run_extract_wiki_tables: run the CLI to extract tables from a Wikipedia dump XML file to a JSONL output file
wiki2text_convert: convert raw Wikipedia wiki markup text into cleaned plain text using the wiki2text function
extract_table_from_html: parse an HTML table string into a structured HtmlTable object with schema annotations
is_valid_table_check: check if an HtmlTable has at least 3 columns and 4 rows using the is_valid_table function
get_pages_from_dump: iterate over pages from a compressed Wikipedia data dump XML file using get_pages_from_data_dump
